RECRUITMENT FRAUD ALERT

Verify first.
Protect your next step.

Important information about recruitment communication, placement promises and the company’s published notices.

Verify recruitment communication

The formal public notice dated 14 June 2025 states that GA Digital does not charge a fee for job placement and is not associated with outside brokers acting independently.

Do not rely on an intermediary promising favored placement. Confirm the vacancy, selection process and any joining requirements directly with the company.

A separate joining notice

A separate joining notice describes a refundable ₹10,000 security deposit at joining, payable in the company’s favor by demand draft, with no cash accepted. This is distinct from a job-placement fee. Verify current applicability directly with the company.

Report a concern

Email info@gadigital.in or call 0120-4218525 using the published company contact details.
